title: FarmingToolTool
description: QoL Mod for farming tools in Hypixel Skyblock
body:
This fabric mod provides QoL features for the farming tools on Hypixel Skyblock.
Current features include:
- Insta breaks cactus on client-side when using the cactus knife, which lowers perceived lag.
- Warns player when they are farming a crop with the wrong tool.

Source code is available on [Github](https://github.com/mumedd/farmingtooltool)
